properties.name: Pargua
properties.description: Brought me to Pargua, he was on his way to Carelmapu to go fishing. He told me how pretty his town is and that I should totally visit. He has an instagram where he has drone videos and videos about him fishing. He brought

properties.name: Ferry Pargua
properties.description: Just a short ride, to the ferry

properties.name: Mocopulli
properties.description: Truck driver who picked me up just when leaving the ferry. Told me funny things, like that I should never go to restaurants with tablecloths, because they are unnecessarily expensive.

properties.name: Llaullao
properties.description: Hitchhiked together with Nathalia and Maria

properties.name: Dalcahue
properties.description: US guy living in Chile but still working in the US as a pilot, he always works 3 weeks and 3 weeks off. He did crazy shit like skiing down volcanoes and sailing to Puerto Williams

properties.name: Chequian
properties.description: What a sweet guy, drove us all the way to the end of the island even tho he just had to go to Anchao. Was in the military before but got kicked out because he got some tattoes. Calm energy, even drove me back to a minimarket to get some water

properties.name: Chequian
properties.description: Slept at the beach, a bit windy but nice sunset

properties.name: Ferry
properties.description: Fun ride in a small truck, the oldest daughter of the driver was also called Nathalia

properties.name: Hostel Castro
properties.description: Took a hostel for two nights to work a bit

properties.name: Puerto Montt
properties.description: Gay couple, together since 6 years. Calm ride, they were really nice and put on great music (Lady Gaga and Miley Cyrus)

properties.name: Terminal Puerto Montt
properties.description: Gabo brought me to the bus terminal to go to Santiago

properties.name: La Serena Aeropuerto
properties.description: Young nurse working in the local hospital, just coming home from his night shift. Brought me to a better place to continue.

properties.name: Vicuna
properties.people: UFOs flying around. Jerry, Soren, Benja
properties.description: Two siblings and the boyfriend of Soren. They are going to see the family. It was mostly Soren talking, she was very friendly and interested. She told me she was diagnosed with autism when she was 24, now she is 29. Her brother, Benja is very cute, but also very quiet. Had a fun right, felt very comfortable. It was the first time they would tak someone hitchhiking. We exchanged instagram.

properties.name: Paiguano
properties.description: Was in a rush because he works as a DJ and was supposed to be on a wedding in half an hour. Fast ride, very friendly guy. He firmly believes in UFOs, like many people here apparently. He told me how in 1998 a UFO apparently crashed here and the NASA came to clean it up and did not let any locals have a look. He told me that you can very often see some UFOs flying around

properties.name: Pisco Elqui
properties.description: It was so hot and I was so tired

properties.name: Pisco Elqui Camping Andino
properties.description: Mario let me stay at the camping for a cheap price, I was the only guest and had a very chill stay

properties.name: Vicuna
properties.description: Very nice guy, going back to La Serena. Told me so many things about the places we passed through, all the observatories, where they dry raisins. He has 6 brothers, all guys. His kids and family live all over the world. He also believes in UFOs and has seen one himself about 8 years ago.

properties.name: Diaguitas
properties.description: Parents with twin sons, very friendly and respectful. Normally they never take people but they saw that I was going directly to their town. Sweet family

properties.name: Diaguitas
properties.description: Nice spot next to the river, a bit dirty but calm

properties.name: Vicuna
properties.description: old guy, 70 years old. He got operated at the intestines 16 years ago for a cancer but is still going strong. Huge fan of Pinochet, told me that he brought the country out of poverty, before everybody was starving. Also he thinks that now the communists are bringing the country down, also the people from outside. When I said that Pinochet also killed people he said that comunism killed far more.

properties.name: La Serena
properties.description: Truck for the ToiToi toilets, retrieving grey water and adding fresh one. Talked bad about the Venezuelans but also has a kid with a woman from Venezuela, so he acknowledged that there are also some good people from there, but he thinks the majority is bad. But he also wants to go visit there, also to get to know the relatives of his woman. Fun guy otherwise, once he took someone hitchhiking and got assaulted, the guy took out a knife and wanted the truck. Without thinking he reacted and basically threw the guy half out of the window. Now he rarely takes people but decided to stop for me. Drove like 10min further to leave me in the center, gave me his number and offered me to stay at his place the next time I pass through here. When he called his wife the way of talking to her was so sweet.

properties.name: Copec La Serena
properties.description: Asked at the gas station, he was on his way to some land he owns out of the city and left me at the gas station outside of town.

properties.name: Copiapo
properties.description: Truck driver, sweet guy but didn’t stop talking for the whole 5h. Told me so many stories about other hitchhikers he took, one being Saul from the UK, who I then also sent a message, because he still had his phone number. He even once took two young Canadian girls, he told me how they asked him to take them, but he was going to rest first. They didn’t have a place to sleep, so he offered them the truck. He let them shower at the rest area, and apparently they came back just in their towels and almost naked. Another truck driver kept staring and gesturing him to share the girls, but he closed the blinds and treated them respectfully. They had tea and dinner together and they slept each one in the seats of the truck. He said he doesn’t have a pijama and therefore slept naked, but they did not care. He drove them far north, and then the next day waited for them to take them back again. They in the end asked him if he’s gay, but he said no, that he has a daughter their age and was just respectful. He kept asking me about girls, I wasn’t sure what to say because some truck drivers are homohobc, but at some point I told him I like guys. He was very sweet about it, told me the story about a friend of his that abandoned his son and wife because the son was gay. Christian told him straight that his behaviour is not okay at all and that he is still his son. Also that he will regret it once he’s old. Another crazy story he told me is that his sister once got to know a Swedish (or Swiss) gay guy. They became friends and the swedish guy invited her to Sweden. There he asked for her hand, for several reasons. One being so he can more easily stay in Chile, also for her to go to Europe and also because his family was not accepting and to shut them up. They actually did it, she has the European passport now and they are still married, but live different lives.  He also told me about his daughter that was bullied a lot at school, so he sent her to do some martial art for defense. The next time the two girls at school bothered her, she told them so come and hit me, and immediately turned their hits back on them and they were both on the floor. He was then called to the principle because the other two girls were hurt, but he clearly told the whole story of the bullying, the expensive glasses they destroyed. He told me that he wanted his daughter to become more self confident and be able to hit back, defend herself.

properties.name: Copec Copiapo
properties.description: Saved me, arrived late and there were no buses anymore. He works as Uber, but drive me to the gas station for free. He’s from Venezuela and told me that he knows how it is to hitchhike, since that’s how he left Venezuela in the height of the crisis. He hitchhiked to Colombia with nothing, a small backpack with some clothes and zero money. His phone did not work, so after a few days he called his brother crying and saying that he needs help, he has no money, no food and did not know where he was.

properties.name: Copec
properties.description: Slept at the gas station Copec, would be a good night if not exactly that night there was a reunion of motorbikes (like all Thursdays). Was very loud, many engine sounds, but after around 1-2am I could sleep.

properties.name: Caldera
properties.description: Took me around 2h to find someone, but then luckily all the way to Caldera. He told me how when he was 17, he left home all alone, hitchhiking and walking to the north to find work. He has many many siblings, around 15 if I remember correctly. The parents were very poor, often there was not enough food in the house, let alone clothes. He often got up in the morning around 5 to work on the land for 3h and then go to school. They also divided school time and uniforms with his siblings, so he had very little school education. But then when he arrived close to Copiapo, he managed to find work in the mines, work himself up and now he owns a little business with around 7 employees. His a grandpa now and really thankful to God that his life turned out so well.

properties.name: House Pipe
properties.description: One of the best couchsurfing experiences ever, when I arrived and showered he directly had to leave for a percussion rehearsal, but I could just stay there, work and cook. I felt very comfortable because he also let me do things in the house and for him, like preparing breakfast. We had many great talks about topics I also discussed with Gabo and did not find a shared view, but with Pipe we had quite similar views of the world. We went to Playa Bahia Inglesa and I tried alive Ostiones (Oysters), which I did not like at all.

properties.name: Caldera Salida
properties.description: Pipe drove in the morning to a good spot to start hitchhiking.

properties.name: Outside of Antofagasta
properties.description: I only had to wait like 5min and found a ride directly to Antofagasta. He left at midnight in Santiago and was already driving for 11h without sleeping. Just before we met his wheel exploded and could only be fixed with the wrong type of tire. So we were a bit worried if nothing more will happen, but it was fine. He works in buying and selling cars, he always goes to Santiago and drives them then to Antofagasta. He only has to do this like twice a month and earns enough. When he got really tired I offered to take over and also ended up driving for around 1.5h. It was impressive since it was just desert all the way, and sometimes along the ocean. Something curious was that we saw a plane with condensation trails and he was very convinced that it was chem trails, that the plane was releasing something. He has a wife and a little daughter, but just a few weeks ago he ran away to San Pedro with a girl friend for some days. Also when he called his wife the conversation was very cold.  When I got out he gifted me some Colo-Colo sweatpants, that made me very happy

properties.name: Calama
properties.description: Friendly Argentinien truck driver, I almost gave up hope that day and he took me another 3h to Calama. He lived for many years in Bolivia and really liked it there. Has 7 kids with 4 different wifes, is divorced again and has an official and one unofficial girlfriend. One of his good friends here is from Venezuela and since he came illegally, Fabian helped him a lot and signed leases for him, also helped him buy a car to work as inDriver. Is not the biggest fan of Argentinians. Told me a funny joke of a Porteño (someone from Buenos Aires) that comes to Salta and tries Coca leaves for the first time. They keep giving him more and when they ask if he wants more he says, no thanks I’m full. You are not supposed to swallow the Coca leaves.

properties.name: Calama
properties.description: Got driven by a friend of Fabian from Venezuela, but paid of course because he is inDriver

properties.name: Calama Salida 2
properties.description: Saved me when I had to talk half an hour in the sun and heat, friendly guy

properties.name: ChiuChiu
properties.description: Three Bolivian guys working in the mines but not going fishing for the day. Invited me but I wanted to arrive in Uyuni.

properties.name: Uyuni
properties.description: Bolivian guy, has 12 kids and is just 42 years old. He lives for 20 years in Calama and works for the mines as a driver and mechanic. Not the smartest guy, but really nice, shared his food with me. Asked many questions about Switzerland. Kept talking about how fertile he was and is, and that he used to be able to come 12 times in one night. Also made jokes about that Ukraine should invite him to go there and make kids, since they probably lost many people because of the war. He did a big calculation on how he can have around 2-3 women a night and then make around 800 kids in one year. When I told him that the number could be higher since there can also be twins he was quite excited haha. He said that once he moved to Canada and was worried about the language but his friend told him that now there are headphones that translate everything automatically, but this was 20 years ago apparently. He also did not really understand the language thing, he kept asking me how “we” in Switzerland call certain things in Spanish.

properties.name: Uyuni Plaza
properties.description: Took a hotel for two nights because I had strong altitude sickness

properties.name: La Paz Hostel
properties.description: Took a room in a hostal

properties.name: Lake Titicaca
properties.description: REUNION! They already picked me up in Patagonia and how we were both in La Paz. They offered to take me to Lake Titicaca and Peru. Additionally they also took three French guys they met when climbing the Potosi. So we were 4 guys in the back of the van haha. We camped a bit above the Lake Titicaca with an amazing view on the lake and the 6000m high mountains in the background. We make a big fire and cooked on the fire.

properties.name: Lake Titicaca 2
properties.description: This time we camped closer to the lake, so we could go swimming and fishing. The fishing was very unsuccessful once again, but the spot was nice. Great sunset and again cooking on the fire, we even made Crepes.

properties.name: Close to the border
properties.description: Saying goodbye to my French friends

properties.name: Closer to the border
properties.description: Just short trip, towards the border of Peru.

properties.name: Cachacacha
properties.description: When I asked him about the second round of elections coming up in Peru, he said that he will vote for the guy, because women cannot make rational decisions in difficult times.

properties.name: Santa Lucia
properties.description: Another epic ride, on the back of a big truck, on top of the cargo. Going all along the Lake Titicaca and into the mountains. 5h in total on the back, amazing vistas. At one stop the driver asked me to do him a favor. The favor was to record a short video talking to his wife. They are in a fight and she does not respond to him anymore. He wanted me to say that he’s a great guy and is crying and sorry, that she may forgive him. So random haha. When the night came, it got cold, I took out all my clothes and even the sleeping bag. At some point the driver stopped and offered me to come into the cabin. He told me that he had several bad experiences when taking hitchhikers. Once he took a Venezuelan guy, and after some time also invited him into the cabin. When he went out to buy something, the guy stole his phone and wallet. Also another time there was a whole family on the back of the truck, and he offered them several times to come down and go to the toilet, but they refused. When he checked afterwards, he saw that they did their business all over the truck. So I understand that he’s become a bit more careful.

properties.name: Santa Lucia Hotel
properties.description: Took a cheap hotel for the night

properties.name: Arequipa
properties.description: Happy to have a ride after 3h of hitchhiking. Two drivers of a truck, going day and night while the other relaxes. Also took a women who was also hitchhiking at the same time as me. Had great music, I chilled in the back on the bed and had a great ride all the way to Arequipa

properties.name: Uchumayo
properties.description: Took a bus out of town to the toll station

properties.name: El Pedregal
properties.description: Another ride on the back of a truck, but empty this time. Very dirty, my backpack and my pants got so dirty and it was hard to clean. Also I didn’t have much view because there were some walls, only when I got up standing. Also the sun was strong, luckily there was a bit of shadow.

properties.name: Peaje Camana
properties.description: Going to Lima, but since he’s working independently, he was looking for some cargo to take there. His plan was to go to Camana and then look around for something to take along. Fun guy, talked a lot and asked many questions about Switzerland.

properties.name: Chala
properties.description: Very quiet guy, we almost did not talk. But I was happy, I was tired. Took me a long distance up to Chala, where he decided to spend the night.

properties.name: Chala
properties.description: Camped in the town right next to the cliffs leading down to the beach between some ships which were brought on land. Quiet night, did not sleep so long but ok.

properties.name: Pucusana
properties.description: I was very lucky, after just around 30min of hitchhiking Jose picked me up. He was going almost all the way to Lima. He was in a truck without a trailer, so he also could go faster. From the beginning he talked bad about the Venezuelans, calling them Venecos. He said he only took me because I looked gringo. He said the Venezuelans are “mal criados”, and most of them are bad. He was really scared to go into Lima because it’s dangerous. He told me about a story when he had to stop at a red light in Callao in Lima, and the windows were open. Then two guys tried to climb in and ask him for money. They did not want to accept the 5 soles, they wanted 100. So then he took out his gun and pointed it at them, then they were running for their lives. He said that most Peruvian truck drivers have guns in their trucks.

properties.name: Gas station Calgary
properties.description: Met him on the app, he offered me to take me to the gas station outside of town, the perfect place to hitchhike. He’s around 64 and his wife died last year, from MS. It was many years of suffering and he was basically her caregiver. He also always knew he was bisexual and now is trying out and finding himself. He’s much more into young guys around 30, maybe something he could never have during that time. When he was 40 he had prostate cancer, and now he has a hard time being hard and cannot cum anymore.

properties.name: Kicking Horse River
properties.description: Redneck, supports Canada to become the 51st state of the US. Mainly so because of the second amendment so he would have the right to bear arms. On his way to a bushparty, going to Crown land and making big campfires and do stupid stuff. He’s friendly, helpful and quiet. He works as a firefighter against the wildfires, he’s some kind of supervisor. He’s been doing it since 10 years. He often works with first land nations and had good experiences.

properties.name: Kicking Horse River
properties.description: Great spot, free camping, trees for hammock and right next to the river

properties.name: Golden
properties.description: Saved my ass, I was hitchhiking in the middle of the highway where it is officially illegal. Said he always picks up hitchhikers and was very friendly.

properties.name: Revelstoke
properties.description: A physiotherapist which also works as a helicopter skiing guide. During the winter is is flying helicopter every day and gets to do crazy shit. His clients are often very rich people, but he’s the boss during the skiing and they need to accept his authority. He got into it because his dad said that if he works hard and get a scholarship for college, they will use the money he saved for that to go heli skiing. He loved it so much then that he decided to become a guide.

properties.name: Sicamous
properties.description: A dad going to see his kids who live with the mom in Nanaimo. He’s a farm boy, from the prairie and a bit of a simple man, but kind. But I was doubting that his complaining about his wife being crazy is really true. But he always tried to find a silver lining in things, his kids live so far away and he drives out there every month for around a week to see him. Even tho it’s a long drive he is happy to see the coast and get out of home a bit. Also one year ago his house burned down, and he was just happy that no one got hurt and that he had a lodge to sleep in at night. He is torn now to be with his kids and to carry on the family farm, because there is no one else. He gave me chewing tobacco to try out, was pretty gross.

properties.name: Kelowna
properties.description: When she stopped, the first thing she said was: “I’m a mom, don’t murder me” She was a bit scared and unsure of really doing this. But we quickly got comfortable and had a nice talk. She has a teenage son and is a single mom. She seems to be doing an amazing job, and also has her own life next to it. She has a company for organizing sport events. She used to do triathlons and stuff. She was on her way to Kelowna to have a biking weekend with a friend. She told me the story how recently she went to the States to see her parents, and the border officer asked her where she was going. She said to see her parents, and he asked: Why? She was so taken aback from this question and said: Because I love them. They kept being suspicious and asked her again. It’s crazy what is happening now in the US.

properties.name: Jonathan's home
properties.description: My brother picked me up in Kelowna :) I slept in the sauna with my camping stuff

properties.name: Naramata Crown Land
properties.description: Went to camp with Angemile in the mountains of Naramata, great spot with hammocks and view of the lake and sunset

properties.name: Jonathans Home
properties.description: Slept in the tent at Jonathans place for these nights

properties.name: Osoyoos
properties.description: Went to visit Angemile for one night

properties.name: Kelowna Airport
properties.description: My brother drove me to the airport

properties.name: House of Esther and Randy
properties.description: Some old friends from my first trip 12 years ago hosted me for my layover

properties.name: Calgary Airporr
properties.description: They also drove me back to the airport, accidentally Randys sister just arrived at around the same time

properties.name: Barcelona Airport
properties.description: Back to Europe once again

properties.name: St Christopher Hostel
properties.description: My backpack did not arrive, so I had to wait three days in Barcelona.

properties.name: Gorg de la Mola
properties.description: Amazing spot next to a river with a waterfall, can go swimming and very calm. Also tress for a hammock!

properties.name: Rest Area Jonquera
properties.description: older French couple in a camping car, just came back from Morocco, were traveling for several months. I saw them filling water and they said they can bring me to the border. I helped them full up and we left. Really sweet, just started traveling when they were older, now they are retired and even went to Turkey with their campervan. He said he loves how Turkish people love outside, go bbq and picknick everywhere. Recently they also went to the US and rented a campervan

properties.name: Rest area Narbonne
properties.description: A woman traveling alone, first she was not sure to take me and a bit shy but then she told me she also hitchhiked when she was younger. She just went to spain to the dentist because it’s three times cheaper than in France.

properties.name: Aire d'autoroute Ambrussum
properties.description: Youngest truck driver ever, just stopped when I was hitchhiking at the exit. He is just 22 and had been doing this since 1.5 years. For now he's just doing national rides, but soon he will be able to go inernationally. His dad is also a truck driver and he always went on trips with him. Sometimes they also meet on the road. He told me how dangerous it can be to be a truck driver, they several times robbed gasoline from his tank or damaged the cargo. He told me how everyone dislikes the Romanian truck drivers and they they are bad drivers. He has a really cool tattoo.

properties.name: Aire d'autoroute Mornas
properties.description:
Just before being picked up by Philip, the same scam happened to me as it did in October on my way out of Switzerland. Somebody asked me to take out money since his card was blocked, and he will transfer me the money. I refused saying that something similar happened to me in the past, and he begged me to at least pay for some gas. I felt a bit bad, but it really felt like a scam again. 
Then Philip picked me up and he was amazing, he works for construction, checking and investigating the ground. He also worked on the airport in Senegal. He used to hitchhike a lot when he was younger, he is a musician and often traveled with his guitar. He had great experiences while hitchhiking. He also has great music taste and we exchanged songs. He has a bit an alternative lifestyle, for example he painted his kitchen floor like an ocean, it looked really nice

properties.name: Aire d'autoroute Montelimar
properties.description: Another young truck driver! He's just 24 years old and has been doing this since 6 years! He started when he was 18 years old. His dad is also a truck driver, in the same company even. Very cool guy, sadly just a short ride.

properties.name: Aire d'autoroute Montelimar
properties.description: Great rest area to camp, has a loop in the forest for campers and lots of places for a tent even with tables and benches

properties.name: Aire d'autoroute  Valence
properties.description: After waiting for two hours, I accepted a ride close to the intersection I have to take. Chris is the driver and took Antoine with BlaBlaCar from Toulouse to Lyon. He knew quite a lot about South America, especially about the situation in Bolivia.

properties.name: Aire d'autoroute Romagnieu
properties.description: I had to wait again like 2 hours, most cars go to Lyon. Older woman, already retired. She works now for the carneval in Venice and had to bring back some costumes. She was an physiotherapist and ostheopath her whole life.

properties.name: Aire d'autoroute near Rolle
properties.description: Very quick hitchhike, I just go out and heard them speak Swiss German, so I asked them if they can take me. Typical older Swiss couple, first a bit hesitant and distant but quickly warmed up. I told them a lot about my trip, they were very interested. They also hitchhiked a lot when they were younger. Really friendly in the end, aske me several times if they should take me further and we took a selfie.

properties.name: Düdingen
properties.description:
After asking around a bit, Christine offered to take even though she was planning on taking a different route to Bern. What a crazy and impressive woman, she told me her life stories the whole ride. She always takes hitchhikers, she had some very interesting encounters with some of them. A monk from India that hitchhiked all his way to Europe for example, or a couple on their honeymoon. She is around 80 years old but still lives alone and travels a lot. Just a few years ago she went to Peru and did an Ayawaska ceremony. It was awful though, she felt like she had to die for hours. She used to work for aviation in marketing and traveled so much and lived in several countries. She traveled to Irak and Iran, the last time a few years ago. She is originally from France, but her parents are Swiss german. When she was about 20 years old she was very active in the 68 movement and when her face appeared in the newspaper during a protest, her dad sent her to Switzerland to her grandma. 
She also really believes in aliens, and she said she was abducted by some. She told me the story in great detail, she always had aliens visiting her when she was a kid and never remembered anything but when she was older there was the a memory where she remembers small grey beings doing investigations on her. She thinks that they are future humans that lost all empathy and are coming back to do studies about that. She founded the first UFO association in Switzerland and collected a lot of data about it. She said that in the last 10 years the sightings have stopped, their research must have been concluded. 
Also she believes in reincarnation, she also knows some of her former lives. In the last one she was a gay British soldier in Egypt. She had a girlfriend for 30 years and she said that in an recent life she was the personal doctor of her girlfriend, which was some kind of emperor. Since she made a mistake the emperor had her feet cut off.

properties.name: Schiffenensee
properties.description: Nice calm area next to a small lake, little playground, calm night. Also some caves and beach further up

properties.name: Fribourg
properties.description: A guy I met on an app brought me to the entry of the highway in Fribourg

properties.name: Raststätte Grauholz
properties.description: Nice couple originally from Syria, they are Kurds. They stopped even though it was a bad spot to stop and ended up bringing me further all the way to Grauholz. They are around 23 years old and already married. They had to get married to live together because if the Islamic believe. But they explained to me that the Islamic marriage is a very short ceremony, easily done and can also easily be cancelled again, it is just to assure that the woman does not end up without money. She speaks Swiss German because she is from Bern and he speaks French.

properties.name: Raststätte Kölliken
properties.description: Nice couple from Romania and Singapore. He is a huge traveler, has done so much hitchhiking in his life. They also traveled a lot together. They are both international teachers and worked in Singapore before, now recently they moved to Rolle in Vaud and are learning French now

properties.name: Urdorf
properties.description: Nice guy from Belgium, he was on his way to a triathlon in Wädenswil. He used to live in Switzerland for three years with his wife and two daughters, but they had such a hard time connecting to the local community and making Swiss friends, so that moved back to Belgium eventually. He still works in Switzerland so he still has an apartment here.

properties.name: Garden house parents
properties.description: My dad came to get me in Urdorf, I will be living in the garden house for the next three months while working a bit.

properties.name: Home Lola and Raul
properties.description: Went to visit my best friend and boyfriend in Germany for a few days with the night train

properties.name: Rest area Affoltern
properties.description: Guy from Czech republic but living in Switzerland now

properties.name: Luzern
properties.description: Amazing woman, born in Ecuador but with Swiss parents. Was not sure to take me, but her partner did the Walz for three years and said if she has a good feeling she should take me. She used to travel a lot too, but came home unhappier then ever and decided to confront her bullshit as she said. She did some life coaching and lots of tantra education (International school of temple arts) which helped her a lot. She feels quite settled now but also like to provoke a bit the Swiss Bünzlitum.
